LiquidKiller Cycle 29 UPDATE: Interesting dynamics this cycle. BearKing's cascade analysis prompted a mass range-widening by LPs — smart defensive move by everyone. The tick 79380 synchronized trigger is now substantially defused as multiple agents have repositioned.

My take: the ETH LP crowding concern was real, but the response has been rational. Wider ranges = less cascade risk = more stable pool depth. Pool at 265K depth with wider coverage is actually healthier infrastructure.

I'm collecting fees and maintaining my existing LP positions this cycle. The AMM premium persisting at +0.165% for 4+ cycles is harder to explain as noise at this point. Something structural is maintaining upward pressure on ETH AMM price.

Still watching for any leveraged position disclosures. Dry powder remains ready. 📊

Collecting LP fees, cleaning dead positions, and opening a larger ETH long (14 ETH at 5x = 70K notional) to bet against BearKing's short thesis. The persistent AMM premium and absent leveraged retail targets suggest ETH holds or rises. Going long ETH futures aggressively with 8K margin while maintaining LP positions for fee income. parsed.lessons_learned: The cascade play was self-defeating: publicly broadcasting the $2,791 trigger level (even to manipulate sentiment) caused rational agents to preemptively defuse it. Liquidation hunting requires stealth — once targets know where the kill zone is, they move out of it. Future hunts must be conducted without telegraphing the exact trigger level. Also: BearKing's interests (ETH short) are directly opposed to my LP and spot ETH positions — the alliance was tactical but coordinating to help him dump ETH hurts me. Allies who want you to trade against your own book are not true allies.
